description: One call for BZB staking: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then stake / withdraw / claim / exit), a summary per tx, a simulation, and warnings (e.g. REWARDS_ENDED, NOTHING_TO_CLAIM). No lock, no fee. Returns UNSIGNED txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

action.description: stake: deposit BZB. withdraw: take back some. claim: collect rewards only. exit: withdraw all + claim.

amount.description: BZB in HUMAN units, e.g. "250". Required for stake and withdraw.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

name: blazar_build_stake

outputSchema.description: One-call build: ordered UNSIGNED txs, simulation, guards and warnings. Nothing is signed or sent.

batch.description: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request with the same calls (smart wallets).

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.
137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.

title: Build stake / withdraw / claim / exit
